description: Woehrer 2026 COCO rotation benchmark (Fischer et al. 2015 labels 1 and 2 of COCO val2014; 1,030 photos), five test seeds, as rebuilt by ORTUS AI. Angles: numpy.random.seed(seed); numpy.random.uniform(0, 360, 1030), assigned in the image order below. Rendering: upstream rotation_utils.rotate_preserve_content(path, angle) (cv2 bilinear rotate with expanded canvas, then centre crop to largest_rotated_rect). Truth = angle (counter-clockwise content rotation, W convention).
image_order_note: The upstream harness assigns angles in unsorted glob order, which depends on the filesystem. This is the order used by our rebuild; per-seed scores are only comparable under the same order.
jpeg_recipe: PIL.Image.save(buf, 'JPEG', quality=Q) on the RGB view (Pillow 11.0.0 defaults: 4:2:0 chroma subsampling, no optimize)
